invariants.rationale: The method operates on 'batch' via method calls (e.g., batch.setColor), indicating that 'batch' must not be null at exit.
Typical UI convention and batch alpha-multiplication use, where alpha values are in [0,1].
'getColor()' is dereferenced (color.a used), so it must not be null at method exit.
Sizes in UI are generally non-negative; negative values would likely be unexpected.
At method exit, 'this.focused' is synchronized with 'hasKeyboardFocus()' to handle focus state changes.
